intro: Duel Alongside Your Partner and Forge Your Own Future!
description:
Your final year at Duel Academy is officially underway!  Select your partner from over 100 visually upgraded characters and conquer your opponents as a Dueling duo! Strengthen your affinity with your classmates and build memories as you study the art of Tag Dueling and prepare for a Graduation Duel to remember! 

Get Your Game On! Classic Dueling is back and rebuilt with over 3,800 cards, including additional fan-favorite cards beyond those featured in the original Yu-Gi-Oh! GX TAG FORCE 3. Build your Deck, develop unique strategies, and enjoy student life at Duel Academy as you Duel your way to victory.

Yu-Gi-Oh! TAG FORCE GX marks the first-ever Americas debut of Yu-Gi-Oh! GX TAG FORCE 3 content, which was previously unreleased in North and Latin America.

《New Features》
・Unleash your inner HERO! Over 3,800 cards, including additional cards supporting GX-era Decks. 
・Class is in Session Explore, investigate and expand your extracurricular activities with new and renewed mini-games. 
・Duel the World Enter a Casual Duel or Room Match to enjoy both Tag and 1v1 Duels with Online Multiplayer!
・Gallery Mode Reminisce with story scenes from Yu-Gi-Oh! GX TAG FORCE and Yu-Gi-Oh! GX TAG FORCE2.

[About "Yu-Gi-Oh!"]
"Yu-Gi-Oh!" is a popular manga created by Kazuki Takahashi that was serialized in SHUEISHA Inc.'s "WEEKLY SHONEN JUMP" since 1996. Konami Digital Entertainment Co., Ltd. provides a Trading Card Game (TCG) and console games, based on "Yu-Gi-Oh!" created from the original manga, that has been enjoyed around the world.
